title: ActionRunner: onSuccess.navigate passes an app-relative path to the console router verbatim, so '/object/id' lands on /_console/home; host it under the current app the way resolveNotificationTarget does
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 动作成功后的跳转 `onSuccess: { navigate: '/crm_opportunity/${result.id}' }` 在控制台里落到 `/_console/home`，而不是新记录。控制台把这个路径原样交给路由器，路由里没有它。
- **要做：** 动作成功后的跳转，像收件箱通知链接一样，把不带应用段的路径放到当前应用下（复用 `resolveNotificationTarget`）。
- **完成标准：** 不写应用 id 的跳转能打开当前应用里的那条记录；写了 `/apps/…` 的跳转照旧。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2247, recorded there at comment `6367379843` (director batch #6 item 1, letter C): 「同意」, 2026-10-23T14:34:48Z. Its item 2(a) orders this objectui card; item 2(b) orders the paired spec card, objectstack-ai/objectstack — number in the comment below. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Suggested grade: `priority:p2`** (the seat's reading; grade, `domain:*` and `area:*` are objectui triage's): spec-valid metadata that parses clean and then silently lands on the wrong page is the metadata-authoring trap class (c), with reach measured in a real browser below. A working spelling exists (the app-qualified path), which is why it is not p1.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage, then the `domain:ui` lane.

## Governing text

- The ruling above, item 2(a): 「ask for the hop to host app-relative paths the same way」.
- `@objectstack/spec` `src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `onSuccess.navigate` (~:1763 on objectstack `origin/main` `2581efbcbd`): "an in-app path starting with / or ./ (an SPA route hop)". Read the way an author reads it, `/crm_opportunity/<id>` is such a path; the console does not deliver it. The wording half is the paired spec card.

## Measured

On `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (`@objectstack/console` 18.0.0), HotCRM `origin/main` `c14ffde`, in a real browser:

- An action with `onSuccess: { navigate: '/crm_opportunity/${result.id}' }` succeeds. The runner hands `/crm_opportunity/<id>` to react-router, whose basename is `/_console`. That makes `/_console/crm_opportunity/<id>`, which matches no route, and the catch-all redirects to `/_console/home`.
- The record's real route is `/_console/apps/<app segment>/<object>/record/<id>`.
- Installed code: `node_modules/@objectstack/console/dist/assets/framework-D2CDLHVn.js`, `ActionRunner.navigateOnSuccess` → `navigationHandler`.

## Where it lands (read on objectui `origin/main` `241cb78bd`)

- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` `navigateOnSuccess` (~:1874–1917): interpolates `navigate`, classifies the scheme, and calls `this.navigationHandler(url, { external, newTab })` with the path unchanged.
- `packages/react/src/context/ActionContext.tsx` (~:123): `onNavigate` becomes the runner's `setNavigationHandler`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` `navigateHandler` (~:355–361): `navigate(url)`, nothing else.
- The precedent: `packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts` `resolveNotificationTarget` (~:328–343, objectui#5179) already sorts the same three shapes for the inbox: a scheme or `//host` is external, `/apps/…` is already a console route, and anything else is hosted under `/apps/<host app segment>`. The card asks for the post-success hop to reuse that resolver (or one shared with it), ⛔ not a second copy of the rule.
- Open question for the lane: hosting belongs where the current app is known (the console handler), not in `@object-ui/core`, which has no app. Whether `type: 'url'` targets take the same resolver is the lane's call; this card asks only for `onSuccess.navigate`.

## Done when

- An `onSuccess.navigate` with no app segment opens the record in the current app: `/crm_opportunity/record/${result.id}`, and the shorthand `/crm_opportunity/${result.id}`, which the console already redirects to `…/record/<id>` once it is inside an app.
- An app-qualified `/apps/<app>/…` path, an external URL and `mailto:` behave as today.
- A pin on the console's handler for each of the three shapes.
- After a release carrying it, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2247's hard-coded `'/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_opportunity/record/${result.id}'` may be shortened. The ruling calls that optional cleanup, not a task: the app-qualified spelling keeps working.

**Size:** S–M.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (36) and every issue updated since 2026-10-09 (697, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged by hand) on 2026-10-23, and matched case-insensitively on their titles; the search API is refused for this session. Words: `onSuccess`, `navigate`, `navigation`, `app-relative`, `current app`, `ActionRunner`, `basename`, `redirectUrl`. Nearest hits: #12755 (closed, the success toast after a url action), #12191 (closed, `mailto:` targets), #12338 (closed, a test row's `onSuccess`). None on point. **New.**
